segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin found it the best cleanser for that skin type and fungal-acne safe, while another with an oily nose (combination) noted it helped clear texture and redness.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dry-sensitive skin mostly report it cleanses without stripping or drying, though a few with extremely dry or sensitive-dry skin found it drying, poor at removing makeup, and unable to calm redness.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it calms redness and helps with texture, including one who uses it as a first step before a cleanser suited to combination skin.
segments.sensitive: The large majority of self-identified sensitive-skin reviewers report the cleanser is gentle, non-irritating, and calming, often citing years of repeat use, though a small number with sensitive or sensitive-dry skin report it dried their skin, stung, or failed to reduce redness.
segments.mature: One 41-year-old reviewer with sensitive skin credits it as part of aging well, but no reviews specifically address mature-skin concerns like fine lines or firmness.
segments.normal: One reviewer describes normal, pale skin prone to redness and reports the cleanser removes mineral sunscreen well and is soothing.

concerns.aging: Only incidental mention: one reviewer pairs it with an age-smart line and one mentions looking good at 41, but no reviewer reports a specific anti-aging effect from the cleanser itself.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers with dry or sensitive-dry skin report no dryness or tightness after use and describe it as hydrating; however, several others explicitly state it dried out their skin, including one who called it 'kind of drying' and another who said it strips and dries despite gentleness claims.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers describe visible reduction in redness, rosacea flare-ups, and general irritation, often citing it as the only cleanser that doesn't aggravate rosacea; one reviewer, however, states it did not calm or address her redness at all.
concerns.barrier: A couple of reviewers report it supports a damaged skin barrier and forms a protective layer before other products; no reports of barrier damage from use.
concerns.spots: Some reviewers with hormonal or cystic acne report significant improvement or full resolution of chin/cystic breakouts after weeks of use; one reviewer, in contrast, says it does not cleanse pores adequately and links two years of use to persistent breakouts that cleared only after stopping.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers note visibly smaller pores, fewer blackheads, and clearer skin after regular use; one dissent reports the cleanser does not remove all makeup or debris, leaving residue detectable with a toner pad.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with an oily nose (combination skin) reports the product helped with excess oil and texture in that area; another states it leaves no oily residue and skin feels non-greasy.

extraits.titre: Love the brand, however I think this is a huge miss…
extraits.texte: I love the brand and have used other products. I've used this specific cleanser for a LONG time. I really wanted it to work as I really do believe in the brand. I have extremely sensitive dry skin. Here are my pros & cons (my opinion): Pros: the wash did not burn my skin Cons: price point, did not calm or address the reddness, has an odd scent, does not lather at all, does not remove makeup at all, even after multiple washes, does not deep clean skin, dries skin out.

I used this for 2 years and couldn't figure out what kept breaking me out. Although this feels nice and gentle, it definitely doesn't cleanse the pores. As soon as I stopped using this, my skin got so clear.

I like this face wash. Although I don't have sensitive face skin I have eczema on my neck and chest and unfortunately this is the only face wash that doesn't seem to aggravate it. I just wish it was slightly more cleansing or exfoliating. I have acne prone skin and feel like this wash doesn't get everything off of my face. I use a retinoid though so it helpful for washing without drying

extraits.titre: Finally found something that cleared my hormonal acne
extraits.texte: Since high school, I have only used Noxzema - which did work as well as it could but wasn't really addressing the stubborn hormonal acne I'd get every month around my period. I'd get painful cystic-type acne around my chin like clockwork. A little over a year ago I went to get a facial and they used the Dermalogica Ultra Calming products on me. I bought it to take home and at first my skin purged but after 2 weeks I noticed my skin was clearer than ever and has been since! I can't even remember the last time I had any acne around my chin (or anywhere else really). I only use the Ultra Calming Cleaner and the Calm Water Gel Moisturizer. I use both in the morning and again before bed, only using The Ordinary Caffeine Serum on my under-eyes otherwise. Couldn't recommend these products enough!

extraits.titre: New must have for sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I really love this product because of the soothing component that it offers my dry-sensitive skin. It makes my face feel so smooth and clean without irritating it at all. With my old face wash (not dermalogica) as soon as I would start to wash my face it would create redness. This just makes it feel great! My redness has already started to decrease so much and my skin looks so happy.

I have so much texture on my skin because it's dry/combination. My nose is oily while everything else is extremely dry. I also have a lot of redness. I started a skin care routine, but i really felt the difference once i started to use this as my first step. My face drastically cleared up! I use this before i go in with my biore cleanser that is meant for combination skin. Im so happy i bought this during the 21 days of beauty.

extraits.titre: Calms skin like the bottle says!
extraits.texte: I'm newer to the Dermalogica line. Based on my skin, I went with the calming line. I was worried this cleanser wouldn't be super effective, since it doesnt foam. Nope! It cleanses skim really well but doesn't strip it. My skin barrier is damaged, so this product is perfect in the repair process. This is my second bottle and will keep buying!
